relationship_to_successor: Resolves ENCODER_FAMILY_AND_REVISION only for lam-arc-contextual-successor-v1-draft. It does not approve a confirmatory dataset, freeze collapse/budget/environment rules, implement B0/T1, or authorize held-out execution.
selection_timing: Selected before successor B0/T1 held-out outcomes and before confirmatory-dataset approval.

encoder.model_class_contract: AutoModel / RobertaModel base encoder, not a task-finetuned checkpoint

tokenizer.withheld_marker_policy: The already-frozen literal [WITHHELD_SPAN] is tokenized by the pinned native tokenizer as ordinary text; no new special token or embedding row may be added.

representation.pooling: attention-mask-weighted arithmetic mean over all non-padding positions, including native special tokens
representation.normalization_after_pooling: none unless separately frozen for all compared systems before outcome access
representation.T1_target_encoder_initialization: exact copy of the same pinned base encoder weights before any successor training; subsequent EMA rule remains a separate implementation/config binding

matching_rules.supervised_input_tokenizer: must equal this artifact for B0 and T1
matching_rules.auxiliary_context_and_target_tokenizer: must equal this artifact for T1

selection_rationale: The successor requires a genuine contextual encoder rather than the predecessor's hashed whitespace-token representation.

DistilRoBERTa is a compact English RoBERTa-family encoder with 6 layers, 768 hidden dimensions and 12 attention heads, reducing compute relative to RoBERTa-base while retaining contextual token representations.
The same immutable pretrained revision can initialize B0 and T1, so encoder choice is not a treatment-specific advantage.
The checkpoint is general-purpose rather than fine-tuned on the successor task.
known_limitations: The checkpoint was pretrained on OpenWebText. This artifact does not establish that candidate ARC/OpenBookQA examples were absent from pretraining data; contamination/overlap remains a limitation and separate freshness-review item.

Pinning a Hub revision does not substitute for local download receipts. Before any admissible execution, retain exact local SHA-256 hashes for every downloaded model/tokenizer/config file and bind them to the run environment.

This artifact does not freeze encoder trainability, classifier-head implementation, optimizer, predictor, EMA decay, collapse thresholds, parameter-match tolerance or compute ratio. Those remain separate blockers.
The approx parameter count and displayed checkpoint size are descriptive metadata, not the final trainable-parameter count used for matched-budget certification.
claim_boundary: This artifact freezes one contextual encoder/checkpoint/tokenizer identity before successor outcomes. It is not evidence that DistilRoBERTa, JEPA, or the successor treatment improves reasoning, generalization, sample efficiency, or representation health.
